pages.task: Subject: "Vine Snare" dark root coils binding the LEGS of an unseen creature. ONE cell, content only in the LOWER 45% of each cell (ground level, centred horizontally). Do NOT draw the creature: leave the middle open and see-through. Colours: DARK bark brown (#4a2f18/#6b4423), deep moss green, few small white thorns; NO pale, beige, tan or cream colours anywhere. Frame 1: dark root tips burst from the soil on both sides. Frames 2-3: 3 to 4 NARROW separate rings of root spiral up and wrap around an invisible leg column about 30% of cell width and only 35% of cell height tall (ankle to knee), tight helix, back strands darker. Frames 4-5: the rings cinch tight with small shock lines, a few torn leaves and a brief green-white flash only on the squeeze. Frames 6-7: they hold, thorns bristling, rings stay thin and low. Frame 8: the rings crumble into DARK soil specks and a few leaf bits (dark brown, not beige), nothing pale left. Central column hollow.
pages.checkRules:
- Exactly 2:1, 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal cells; NO grid lines/borders/numbers/text.
- Background really transparent (no black, no magenta residue, no dark halo, no black rectangle); corners and cell borders transparent.
- Every frame fully inside its cell with transparent margin; no content crossing cell borders; no empty frame.
- Frames form one smooth animation: same centre/size logic between neighbours, no sudden jump, frame 1 visible, frame 8 fading remnant.
- One bold readable subject per frame, hand-painted medieval style, no neon/sci-fi/purple/noise, no characters, no text.
- Reads as root-vine coils spiralling and cinching around an EMPTY central column (no creature drawn); thorny, bark-brown with moss; helix stays centred and same size from frame 3.
- Central column see-through so a mob behind remains visible.
- Content stays low (ground to knee height, under ~45% of cell height); rings are narrow and separate, not a tall bundle.
- Dark bark brown + moss only; no beige/tan/cream; final frame has no pale silhouette.
